simple.meaning: סְבָאִי (Çᵉbâʼîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Sebaite , or inhabitant of Seba.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סְבָאִי (H5436) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in סְבָאִי (H5436) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: סְבָאִי (Çᵉbâʼîy) / H5436 is traced through Isaiah 45:14 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a Sebaite , or inhabitant of Seba
definitions.full: H5436. Sebaim סְבָאִים noun plural, of a people Seba'im , ᵐ5 οἱ Σαβαειμ , A Σεβωειμ ; — ׳וּס מִדָּה אַנְשֵׁי Isa 45:14 (+ כּוּשׁ , || מִצְֹרַיִם , compare 43:3 above); this perhaps intended also by Ezek 23:42 Qr (see סָבָא ), perhaps confounding it with שְׁבָא , compare ᵑ6 .
